justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/compare/ComparableUtils.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/compare/ComparableUtilsTest.java. The class is 246 lines and contains one private constructor, one nested ComparableCheckBuilder with 6 public comparison predicates plus 2 private helpers, and 9 public static factory/utility methods; all of them are thin wrappers around Comparable.compareTo or ObjectUtils.compare for the same comparison-related concern. The test file exercises only that single API surface and shows no unrelated responsibilities or separate abstractions, so the class is cohesive rather than insufficiently modularized.
